title: Insights into docking in megasynthases from the investigation of the toblerol trans-AT polyketide synthase: many alpha-helical means to an end.
authors: Scat, Serge; Weissman, Kira J; Chagot, Benjamin
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过整合结构生物学表征了toblerol trans-AT聚酮合酶中一对无序对接结构域(IDR)折叠成新型三α-螺旋复合物的机制，揭示了IDR介导蛋白互作的拓扑可塑性，对无序蛋白PPI机制建模具有直接启发。
abstract: The fidelity of biosynthesis by modular polyketide synthases (PKSs) depends on specific moderate affinity interactions between successive polypeptide subunits mediated by docking domains (DDs). These sequence elements are notably portable, allowing their transplantation into alternative biosynthetic and metabolic contexts. Herein, we use integrative structural biology to characterize a pair of DDs from the toblerol trans-AT PKS. Both are intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) that fold into a 3 alpha-helix docking complex of unprecedented topology. The C-terminal docking domain ((C)DD) resembles the 4 alpha-helix type (4HB) (C)DDs, which shows that the same type of DD can be redeployed to form complexes of distinct geometry. By carefully re-examining known DD structures, we further extend this observation to type 2 docking domains, establishing previously unsuspected structural relations between DD types. Taken together, these data illustrate the plasticity of alpha-helical DDs, which allow the formation of a diverse topological spectrum of docked complexes. The newly identified DDs should also find utility in modular PKS genetic engineering.
abstract_zh: 模块化聚酮合酶（PKS）生物合成的保真度依赖于由对接结构域（DDs）介导的连续多肽亚基之间的特定中等亲和力相互作用。这些序列元件具有显著的便携性，可移植到替代的生物合成和代谢环境中。在此，我们利用整合结构生物学方法表征了来自toblerol反式AT PKS的一对DDs。两者均为 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs)，折叠成具有前所未有的拓扑结构的三α-螺旋对接复合物。C端对接结构域（(C)DD）类似于4α-螺旋类型（4HB）的(C)DDs，这表明同一类型的DD可被重新部署以形成不同几何形状的复合物。通过仔细重新审视已知的DD结构，我们进一步将此观察扩展到2型对接结构域，建立了DD类型之间先前未被怀疑的结构关系。综合来看，这些数据展示了α-螺旋DDs的可塑性，其允许形成多样化的拓扑谱系对接复合物。新鉴定的DDs也应在模块化PKS基因工程中找到应用价值。
